overview: The committee discussed strategies to modernize council communications and outreach, planned biannual diversity, equity, and inclusion training for councilors, and reviewed pending committee items on the 2024–2025 governing agenda.

items.title: Modernizing council communications and outreach strategy (Resolution 24-015)
items.summary: Councilor Tseng presented options including monthly summaries, short-form videos with Medford Community Media, and print updates, leading to approved motions to solicit feedback from the city communications director and keep the paper in committee.

items.title: Biannual diversity, equity, and inclusion training (Resolution 24-022)
items.summary: The committee voted to invite Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Director Frances Nwaje to an upcoming meeting to discuss formats and Open Meeting Law parameters for council training, and voted to keep the paper in committee.

items.title: Review of 2024–2025 council governing agenda (Resolution 24-006)
items.summary: Councilor Tseng provided status updates on upcoming ordinances, including gender equity and youth commissions, welcoming city policies, data equity, and Human Rights Commission reforms, with the committee agreeing to keep the document active in committee.
